current_evidence: The PDF is titled 'Planning Application Validation Checklist 2026', published May 2026. The council's Record of Decision shows the new Local Validation List was approved on 1 April 2026 after consultation.

issues.detail: The list date 2026-07-01 comes from PDF CreationDate metadata. The document says it was published May 2026, and the list was formally approved on 1 April 2026.
issues.evidence: 'Planning Application Validation Checklist 2026', published May 2026; Record of Decision Local Validation List, 1 April 2026

issues.detail: Building for a Healthy Life Assessment is not captured. It is required for all major residential development (full and outline) or sites over 0.5 ha.
issues.evidence: Part Two item 23 Building for a Healthy Life Assessment

issues.detail: Open Space Assessment is not captured. It is required for loss of allocated or incidental green/open space, or where open space is required in new development under Policy SP37 / SPD 13.
issues.evidence: Part Two item 36 Open Space Assessment

issues.detail: Geology Report (proposals that could affect a Local Geological Site) and Security Considerations Assessment (NPSA guidance, recommended) are not captured.

The Coal Mining Risk Assessment is placed under Householder, but the source applies it only to non-householder applications in Development High Risk Areas. Grokbot's own excerpt says 'All non-householder applications'.
issues.evidence: Item 25: 'Required for: All non-householder applications which fall within the Coal Mining Development High Risk Area'

issues.detail: Listed building consent has only 'Advertisement drawings / illumination' and 'Lighting Assessment' rows, which come from the external lighting requirement. It is missing the Heritage Statement, which the source explicitly requires for Listed Building Consent, and the Structural Survey for demolition of listed buildings.
issues.evidence: Item 33 Heritage Statement 'Required for: Listed Building Consent...'; item 41 Structural Survey

issues.detail: About 30 Full planning rows are 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning'. Outline is recorded as '(none)', yet several items name outline applications explicitly: Building for a Healthy Life (full and outline), Landscape Strategy (full or outline where landscaping is not reserved), and Planning Statement / SCI for all major applications.
issues.evidence: Item 31: 'full or outline applications (where landscaping is not reserved)'

issues.detail: Several Full planning rows quote text from a different requirement. 'Schedule of works (listed building)' quotes contaminated land remediation text. 'Sequential / Exception Test (flood)' quotes the retail town-centre sequential test. 'Crime prevention / Secured by Design' quotes a list of DAS topics. 'Pre-application advice' quotes S106 heads-of-terms text.
issues.evidence: trigger 'a remediation/method statement, sufficient evidence should be provided to indicate that there is no contamination...'

issues.detail: Some triggers are cut-off fragments with no threshold. Flood Risk Assessment ('by an Flood Risk Assessment.') omits 1 ha+ in Flood Zone 1 and all development in Zones 2/3. Noise ('supported by a noise assessment prepared by a suitably qualified acoustician.') and Heritage ('...will vary according to the particular circumstances of each application.') are similar.

Many tab_items are contents-page fragments or process text rather than requirements. Examples: 'Invalid Applications .......... 3 5.', 'General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and Redaction ...... 8 PART TWO:', the 15MB file size limit, paper submission copies, PDF photo format, the EIA thresholds link and redaction guidance. The 'Highways / access details' row quotes site-plan content.

The Word version (file/5034) of the same list was extracted as well, so tab_items repeat (e.g. 'All photographs should be submitted in PDF file format', the GDPR contents line, and the minor-application review text). The Transport Assessment and Travel Plan rows share an identical trigger.

summary: Grokbot's link is Rotherham's current Validation Checklist 2026 (approved 1 April 2026, published May 2026), but its date is taken from file metadata. The extraction misses BfHL, Open Space, Geology and SCA items, places coal mining under Householder, omits the Heritage Statement for listed building consent, and has several cross-wired triggers.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
